breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 240 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.2.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'dt=0.001 for 240 implicit Euler steps to reach T=0.2', which is mathematically inconsistent (240*0.001=0.24≠0.2). The ground truth corrects this to 200 steps (200*0.001=0.2). The agent repeated the original error instead of fixing it.
